div.div:
Each replica has a unique group, so every connection node receives each event.
A single shared tracking group would load-balance events and miss clients.
Target must be proven with two replicas; clean up stale groups and size lag / load.
One Delivery/SSE replica is the simpler non-HA full-flow demo starting point.

div.div:
Reconnect: canonical REST GET + latest state version; discard stale events.
Fetch-based SSE supports Authorization header; never put JWT in URL.
Rate-limit public tracking; redact addresses, phones and proof.
Ingress: disable buffering, configure timeouts; heartbeats / backpressure.
